description: Source code for a Zephyr RTOS shell command module to interact with RTC (Real-Time Clock), including functions for parsing date/time strings, setting, and getting RTC time via shell commands.

methods.name: consume_chars
methods.description: Consumes a specified number of characters from a string, copying them into a destination buffer.

methods.name: consume_char
methods.description: Consumes a specific character from the start of a string if it matches.

methods.name: consume_date
methods.description: Parses a date string in YYYY-MM-DD format into a tm structure.

methods.name: consume_time
methods.description: Parses a time string in HH:MM:SS format into a tm structure.

methods.name: strptime
methods.description: Reduced implementation of strptime supporting ISO8601, time, and date formats.

methods.name: cmd_set
methods.description: Shell command to set RTC time based on provided argument.

methods.name: cmd_get
methods.description: Shell command to get and display RTC time.
